title: FLA import: text anti-alias method (CSMTextSettings mode) not decoded
description: Flash 8 text Properties-panel parity / golden-pair gap. The anti-alias dropdown (Use device fonts | Bitmap text [no anti-alias] | Anti-alias for animation | Anti-alias for readability | Custom) maps to the antiAlias field (device/bitmap/animation/readability/custom) plus csm sharpness/thickness. The model, UI, and SWF compile (CSMTextSettings tag 74) all support it, but FLA import (packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts) NEVER decodes it — every imported text field defaults to antiAlias=animation. The golden fixture's 'Score: 0' field is 'Anti-alias for readability', so this is lost on round-trip. Decode the font-rendering mode (and custom sharpness/thickness) from the binary text record. Acceptance: golden import yields antiAlias=readability for that field and the published SWF emits the matching CSMTextSettings.
